name: Copilot CLI
description: GitHub's Copilot CLI. It reads its model from settings.json, but points at a custom (BYOK) provider only through `COPILOT_PROVIDER_*` environment variables — which OSW delivers through a sourced env file.

files.purpose: Main config: the selected model (or `auto`). Not where the provider is set.
OSW-owned environment file: the BYOK provider address/key and model, loaded into the login shell.

fields.description: GitHub-hosted model selection, or `auto`; overridden by `COPILOT_MODEL` in BYOK mode.
Model id sent to the BYOK provider.
